title: Pump unreachable alarm
body:
I have been getting this alert twice now on consecutive Dash pod replacements.
I just got it on 3.4.2.3.  The previous one I replaced was 3 days ago when I was using the previous version of AAPS.

After I connect to the new pod, it asks me to prepare the sire and insert.  While I am dong that, which takes about 2 minutes, I hear this alert.

After I insert the new pod and proceed and it inserts the cannula, I go back to the AAPS home screen, where I see this alert and snooze it.  And everything works fine after that.

The problem is that while I am going thorough the steps doing everything I should be doing, hearing an alert is not the most comforting thing.  
If communication with the pod terminates unexpectedly, of course I need to know to take action.  But, if I have ended a pod and have not started the new one yet, of course the pump will be unreachable.  What would be the point of alerting me only a few minutes after I have intentionally disabled a pod?

Am I doing something wrong that causes this?  
Is there a setting I need to change so that I won't get this alert so fast?

comments.body:
I replaced a pod yesterday and did not get this alarm.
But, I had changed nothing compared to the previous time.  So, I'm not sure what causes this when it happens.

There is a setting that lets you enable or disable this alert.  
I am going to open a feature request suggesting a time parameter to be added to the setting if possible.
